user.title: Connect Google Fi
user.description: Use the browser setup helper in the [setup guide]({setup_url}): sign in to Google Fi, copy the setup code, and paste it below. No data pause is needed. The code grants Google account access; submit it only to your trusted Home Assistant over HTTPS or a trusted private LAN.

lines.title: Choose phone lines
lines.description: Choose the lines this integration may control. On enables mobile data; off pauses mobile data indefinitely. A persistent Home Assistant alert warns if access fails.

reauth_confirm.title: Restore Google Fi access
reauth_confirm.description: Use the browser helper to copy a fresh setup code from the same Google Fi account. No data pause is needed. Until access recovers, a paused line may stay paused. Use [Google Fi]({fi_url}) for direct control.

error.invalid_session: The setup code is invalid. Copy it again using the browser helper in the setup guide.
error.no_lines: This account returned no phone lines. Sign in as the Fi group owner and capture a fresh session.
error.cannot_connect: Google Fi did not accept this session or could not be reached. Sign in again, copy a fresh setup code, and retry.
error.account_mismatch: This session has no phone lines in common with the configured account. The existing session was kept.
error.storage_failed: Home Assistant could not save the session. Check its configuration directory permissions.
error.select_lines: Select at least one phone line.
error.session_rejected: Google rejected the copied session. Sign in to Fi again and copy a fresh code. If Chrome keeps failing, try a fresh Firefox capture.
error.sign_in_required: The copied cookies did not open a signed-in Fi account page. Check the intended account and the helper’s Google cookie permissions, then copy again.
error.account_identity_missing: Fi’s account page did not provide a usable member ID. Check that the intended Fi owner account is signed in; the page format may also have changed.
error.http_429: Google is limiting sign-in checks. Wait before trying again. The existing configured session was kept.

abort.already_configured: This Google Fi account is already configured.
abort.account_already_configured: This Google Fi account is already configured. Use Configure on its existing entry to change phone lines.

init.title: Manage phone lines
init.description: Select the lines to expose and choose failure notifications for this account. Adding or removing a control does not change data in Google Fi. A removed line may remain paused: resume it in Fi first if needed. You can deselect all lines to keep only account health monitoring.

error.reauth_required: The account could not be read. Restore this account’s authentication in Home Assistant, then reopen Configure.
error.select_lines: Choose only lines listed for this account.
